fact: A peer-reviewed feasibility study by Josiline Chigwada (Chinhoyi University of Technology) finds from web content analysis that Zimbabwe has no open data policy in place and is not an Open Government Partnership member, and recommends that a national policy be crafted and enacted; the document gives no finding date, so the 2022-08-12 publication date is used.
The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025) that Zimbabwe has no open data portal; the line gives no year, so the 2025 survey round is used.
